# Transcription probe fixture

`transcription.wav` is fixed synthetic speech saying “Hello.”, generated offline
using the installed Windows SAPI Microsoft Zira voice on 2026-11-20. It is mono
16 kHz, 16-bit PCM and contains no user recording or external service data.

The spoken sample lets speech recognition return meaningful text. Silence or
a tone can legitimately yield an empty transcription from a healthy model.
